snippet.title: TimelineTown | Social Media Life Simulator #steam #simulation
snippet.description:
Invite your friends to TimelineTown and experience a social media world that keeps expanding!

SNS Simulation Game TimelineTown
Scheduled for release on Steam on Thursday, May 28, 2026!

Genre: SNS Simulation
Platform: Steam
Price: 4.99$
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4702980/TimelineTown/

It all starts with just a few followers.
But before you know it, your timeline is overflowing with notifications, trends, and viral posts.

TimelineTown is a cozy social media simulation game where you create and grow your very own online space.

■ Perfect for players who…
・Love relaxing simulation games
・Enjoy watching numbers grow higher and higher
・Want a chill, idle-style experience
・Like customizing their own virtual social platform

■ Watch your account explode in popularity!
Start with just a few likes and followers…
Then grow into tens of thousands — or even more!

Enjoy the satisfying feeling of watching your numbers grow.

■ Customize your social platform
・Theme colors
・Background music
・Profile icons
・Custom bios
・Japanese / English language support
・Adjustable text size

Your social media world grows based on your style and creativity.

Check out TimelineTown and build your own online community!

■ All characters in the game can be added as friends!
[Featured Creators / Video Participants]
Yakumo Yamata-八岐やくも
Chiruha Kaganomiya-鏡宮ちるは
